title: Ominous Decade
text: The Ominous Decade was the period of the history of Spain encompassing the last ten years of Ferdinand VII's reign, dating from the abolition of the Spanish Constitution of 1812 on 1 October 1823 to his death on 29 September 1833. The decade began with the restoration of Ferdinand to the throne with the assistance of the French and saw the suppression of numerous revolts around Spain coming from both the Liberal and ultra-Reactionary sides.
